jobs.title: AI Consultant
jobs.description: Who we are Artefact is a leading global consulting company dedicated to accelerating the adoption of data and AI to positively impact people and organizations. We specialize in data & AI transformation and data marketing to drive tangible business results across the entire enterprise value chain for our clients. Artefact offers the most comprehensive set of data-driven solutions per industry, built on deep data science and cutting-edge AI technologies, delivering AI projects at scale in all industry sectors. From strategy to operations, we offer an end-to-end approach and solutions: data strategy, data quality and governance, data platforms, AI Factory, data-driven customer experience and marketing ROI. Our 1500+ employees operate in 22 countries (Europe, Asia, Americas, Middle East, Africa) and we partner with 1000+ clients, including some of the world’s top 300 brands such as Heineken, Mars, Samsung and L’Oréal. What you will be doing : Our Data Consulting department leads the way in effectively exploiting data & AI in all its forms. Do you want to help our clients define best-in-class data & AI strategies, drive transformations and build data & AI solutions that have impact? Join our dynamic consulting team and contribute to developing our international client portfolio! As an AI Consultant, you will support national and international clients across various industries in developing and implementing innovative data & AI strategies. Your role will encompass: Client advisory : collaborate with clients alongside your (international) team to understand their business needs and goals, delivering data-driven recommendations that guide decision-making and strategy. Data Collection and organization : collect, clean, and prepare data for analysis, correcting errors and formatting it for statistical software. Ownership of project stream: drive individual workstreams, ensuring successful and timely delivery, in alignment with project goals. Data analysis and interpretation : use tools like Excel, SQL, and Python to analyze data, apply statistical techniques to uncover trends and patterns, and present clear, actionable insights to clients, ensuring clarity for both technical and non-technical audiences. What we are looking for Educational background: a completed Bachelor degree, ideally focusing on Technology or (Business) Economics (MSc, MBA), with strong academic performance. Work experience : 6–12 months in internships or student roles in consulting, data/analytics, marketing, advertising, finance, or tech is a plus but not required. Business acumen : you possess a dual profile in ‘business’ and ‘data,’ with a keen eye for identifying business opportunities. Technical proficiency : you have strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; knowledge of statistical software and programming languages such as R or Python is an advantage. Analytical mindset : strong analytical abilities with attention to detail, comfortable working with large datasets. Language proficien

jobs.description: Who is Artefact? Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks. Main Responsibilities You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory. Build modern data platforms: End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost. Engineer pipelines: Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in. Migrate and modernize: Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over. Make data ready for AI: Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on. Run it properly: Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control. Advise and support: Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals. Strong Tech Ecosystem: Certified peers across Artefact and close partnerships with leading data and cloud platforms. Growth and Culture: Certifications, training, international missions, and a team of doers who move fast and support each other. If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Tell us about your passion, curiosity, and impact.

jobs.title: Certified Research Analyst (CRA)
jobs.description: E-Store Refer and Earn (0) Certified Research Analyst (CRA) CRA ( Certified Research Analyst) Certification is ranked #1 by United States International Market Research Consortium (USIMRC), Global Research Syndicate (USA) and Market Research Experts Forum. Course Content Overview Key Benefits Training Options Batch Schedule Test Your Skills Corporate Training 4.5 Ratings Total 7000+ Professionals Trained Assisting to pass In the First Attempt! The Group with 39 years of Business Excellence! Overview The CRA Certification offered by the International Institute for Procurement and Market Research (IIPMR) is for anyone including college students, graduates or postgraduates interested to start a career in market research. Work experience is not required to enroll for this first level Certification. Since CRA Certification is globally recognized, students armed with this certification are the recruiter’s first choice for job positions such as Market Research Analyst, Market Research Executive, Research Associate and Market Research Officers. Who can do this course? Contrary to popular belief, Market Research is not marketing. It is more of Industry data analysis and data interpretation. Market Research is nothing but collecting, analysing and interpreting data in order to produce useful information with actionable insights. Market Research is also known as Business research or Market Intelligence. All types of Research such as Media Research, Patent Research, Equity Research, Financial Research, and Procurement Research fall within Market Research. Anybody with a passion for research can do this course. Anybody who is interested to make a career in Research. Key Features By passing the exam for Certified Research Analyst (CRA), you will join an elite group of professionals who have demonstrated a commitment to excellence in Market Research. The CRA designation can be mentioned after your name just like a Ph.d. The CRA designation will also be a proof of your technical expertise and will enhance your credibility in the Industry. The CRA Certification is valid for life time and there is no renewal fee as such. Hence upon successful completion of the exam, there is no need to take any additional exams or pay additional fees in the future. IIPMR provides regular updates to its members via email on the latest trends in Market Research, News and new techniques in order to stay updated. The certification provides individuals with recognition as a professional ready to work effectively in the Job market. Produce technical documentation, standards, and best practices for automation across the organization. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience). Minimum of 2 years of professional software development or automation engineering experience. jobs.title: Finance Risk 1LOD Senior Analyst
jobs.description: Role/Team Overview: Citi Treasury safeguards the balance sheet, capital, and liquidity of Citigroup while providing oversight of liquidity, interest rate and currency risks. Payments, clearing and settlement (PCS) solutions provided by Citi business lines to institutions and individuals requires the firm to maintain sufficient liquidity during operating hours to ensure the timely completion of those services. Intraday liquidity (IL) management activities and resources bridge timing gaps between client funding activities and Citi’s completion of those PCS activities on behalf of those clients. Several treasury functions work with each other as well as business partners to ensure those resources are available to meet client needs and to support an orderly market for these systemically important processes. The Intraday Liquidity team within Treasury leads the firm’s Intraday Liquidity Target State objectives and the development of IL strategy, operating framework, reporting and governance. Objectives of the team also include optimization of existing practices as well as proactive preparation for market changes and regulatory changes including instant, 24/7 payment processes as well as cash and securities digitization solutions. The Senior Analyst will demonstrate a broad understanding of IL management practices and an awareness of the business drivers that contribute to the use of that liquidity. Analytical experiences should highlight the candidate’s ability to diagnose issues and identify opportunities within a dynamic environment. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: About The Role Alpha isn’t a chatbot sitting on top of a product. It’s an agent that reads a customer’s account, reasons about their plan, and prepares real orders for them to confirm. The model is the easy part. The hard part is everything around it: the tools it calls, the context it sees, how a request gets routed, the guardrails that keep it away from anything that must be exact, and the deterministic systems underneath that place orders, move money and consume events. You’ll own parts of that system end to end, from spec to production. When something goes wrong in a conversation, you’ll be the one who opens the traces and finds where the run went wrong. You’ll decide whether the fix belongs in a tool, a prompt, the routing, the backend or the model, and prove it with an eval. Then you’ll explain it so product, design and other squads can act on it. Much of the work crosses squads. Alpha integrates with Thndr’s order, funding, savings and market-data services, so you’ll write proposals other teams adopt as well as code. We also work with served models beyond Alpha, so some of the work goes below the API: choosing, evaluating, fine-tuning and serving models for other Thndr products. We work through coding agents every day. We expect you to be very good at running your own and at helping others fix their workflows. This is an R&D role, and we hire for breadth on purpose. Most of your time goes to Alpha, but the same person who fixes a routing failure on Monday might be benchmarking an open model, prototyping an agent for another squad, or testing whether a new technique is worth adopting by Friday. We expect you to pick up unfamiliar problems quickly, take them from research to something running in production, and know when an experiment should stop. What You'll Do • Own parts of Alpha end to end. Take a module, such as a tool family, the evaluation pipeline or an integration, and be accountable for how it behaves, its quality in production, and its long-term health. Don’t just follow the design we have: change it when it’s wrong. • Design the harness. Tool contracts that read as the model’s instructions, context the model can use, routing between capabilities, and guardrails that move must-have rules out of prompt text and into code. Start from the behaviour a customer needs and work back to the component. • Build observability and evaluation that people trust. Read traces before building dashboards. Categorise real failures and fix the most upstream one first. Build evals that check the resulting state, not just the final message. Validate LLM judges against human labels. Know the noise floor before calling something a win or a regression. • Run Alpha like a production service. Own latency, reliability and cost for your area: time to first token, end-to-end turn latency, streaming, provider rate limits and fallbacks, and cost per conversation. Set the budgets, monitor them, and get paged when they break. • Engineer the deterministic parts pro

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (AI / Claude)
jobs.description: We are looking for a full-stack developer who already works with Claude every day and knows how to get real engineering work out of it — not someone who has only tried it once. You will build and maintain the systems that run our business: our WordPress websites, our WHMCS billing portal and its custom modules, our internal automation, and the AI tooling around all of it. What you will work on Custom PHP modules and hooks for WHMCS — billing, provisioning, payment gateways and customer messaging. WordPress and Elementor: custom snippets, mu-plugins, front-end work and performance. Automation in Python and Bash on Linux/cPanel servers, including scheduled jobs, reports and monitoring. AI tooling: Claude Code workflows, MCP servers, and integrations that connect our systems to AI assistants. REST APIs and third-party integrations — domain registrars, payment processors, messaging providers. What we expect Strong, demonstrable experience with Claude , and with Claude Code in particular, on real projects rather than demos. Be ready to show what you built with it and how. Solid PHP and JavaScript, comfortable with MySQL, and able to read and write Python. The Linux command line, Git, and enough server sense to debug a live site without breaking it. WordPress internals — hooks, the loop, custom post types — and ideally WHMCS. Care with production systems: you take a backup before you change anything, and you verify your work afterwards. Good written English. Arabic is a plus. What we offer Fully remote work — you can be based anywhere, as long as your hours overlap with our working day in the United Arab Emirates. A monthly salary of USD 500 . A Claude subscription paid for by the company . Real ownership: from your first weeks you will work on systems that serve hundreds of customers. A team that has been delivering IT solutions in the United Arab Emirates since 2003. How to apply Apply through the form on this page. Send your CV and a short note about one thing you built with Claude and how you built it — a link to the code or to a running system is worth more to us than a long cover letter.

jobs.title: Cash Posting Supervisor | Hospital Revenue Cycle
jobs.description: Job Family : PFS General Travel Required : None Clearance Required : None This is a 100% On-Site role at our San Antonio, TX office. Schedule is Monday-Friday from 8AM-4:30PM. What You Will Do: The Cash Posting Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily cash posting and payment reconciliation functions for hospital and healthcare revenue cycle operations. This position ensures that patient and payer payments, adjustments, denials, and other financial transactions are posted accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies, procedures, and internal controls. The supervisor provides day-to-day leadership to the Cash Posting team, monitors productivity and quality, ensures daily deposits and payment activity are balanced and reconciled, resolves posting discrepancies, and partners with Revenue Cycle, Patient Financial Services, Finance, and other operational teams to address issues impacting cash reconciliation. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong cash posting and reconciliation experience, excellent critical-thinking skills, and experience working within hospital patient accounting systems, including Epic, MEDITECH Magic, and MEDITECH 6.x/Expanse environments . jobs.title: How to become a data scientist
jobs.company: Airtics - Project Management and Outreach Office
jobs.description: Written by the Airtics Education academic team · Reviewed by an Airtics program advisor TL;DR: To become a data scientist in the UAE: build core skills (Python, statistics, SQL, machine learning), earn a recognised qualification, build a portfolio of real projects, and network locally. You can do all of this while working full-time. Here’s the step-by-step. Step 1, Learn the core skills Start with Python, statistics, SQL and the fundamentals of machine learning and data visualization. If you’re new to coding, a focused program like Mastering Python for Data Science is a sensible first step. Step 2, Earn a recognised qualification A recognised qualification gets you past the CV screen. Depending on your goal, choose a PG Diploma in Data Science & AI to switch roles quickly, or an online Master’s in Data Science for long-term seniority. Not sure which? See our guide on how to choose the right course . Step 3, Build a portfolio Three to four real projects beat any certificate alone. Use UAE-relevant data, transport, real estate, retail, public services, to show employers you can solve local problems. Step 4, Specialise Generalist data science is competitive. Specialisations like NLP or computer vision face less competition and often pay more. Step 5, Network and apply GITEX, meetups and LinkedIn communities are where UAE roles get filled. For the pay you can expect, see data scientist salaries in the UAE . FAQ How long does it take to become a data scientist? With focused study alongside work, many professionals are job-ready in 9 to 18 months depending on their starting point. Can I become a data scientist without a technical background? Yes, start with foundational Python and statistics, then build up. Many career-switchers in the UAE do exactly this. Ready to start? Talk to an Airtics advisor on WhatsApp or request a callback. Want guidance on your next step? Thinking about upskilling? Tell us your goal and an Airtics advisor will point you to the right program, with no obligation. jobs.title: Snr Applied AI Architect
jobs.description: Description A client of byteSpark.ai is seeking a Senior Applied AI Architect to lead the architecture and delivery of advanced AI solutions for high-volume telecommunications and government use cases. The successful candidate will define end-to-end architectures spanning large language models, natural language processing, speech recognition, computer vision, diffusion models, and multimodal analytics. This role will translate complex business, security, data, and performance requirements into documented system components, interfaces, deployment patterns, and implementation roadmaps. The architect will guide engineering teams through model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, integration, optimization, and reliable production deployment. They will design scalable machine learning pipelines capable of processing real-time and batch voice, text, image, and data streams containing billions of data points. The position requires ownership of key technical decisions involving distributed training, inference infrastructure, MLOps, privacy, observability, resiliency, and cost-performance tradeoffs. The architect will collaborate with product, data, platform, security, and client stakeholders to integrate AI capabilities with existing applications, data sources, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems. They will establish standards for responsible AI, reproducibility, model monitoring, technical documentation, and measurable solution quality. The role also includes mentoring engineers, communicating architecture to technical and nontechnical audiences, and evaluating emerging AI methods that can deliver practical business and operational value. Requirements At least 7 years of relevant AI or machine learning experience, including senior ownership of production AI architecture and delivery across complex initiatives. Expert-level Python skills and substantial hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face Transformers, or comparable deep learning frameworks. Demonstrated expertise architecting large language model and NLP solutions using transformer architectures such as GPT, BERT, T5, LLaMA, or comparable models. Hands-on experience with speech and audio processing architectures, including ASR technologies such as Whisper or Wav2Vec2 and real-time or batch voice pipelines. Proven ability to design and deploy end-to-end multimodal AI pipelines encompassing data ingestion, model training, evaluation, serving, integration, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Strong knowledge of model adaptation and optimization techniques, including LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX, or TensorRT. Production experience with distributed computing and MLOps technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Ray, Apache Spark, DVC, and cloud-based machine learning platforms. Ability to translate business, security, scalability, and performance requirements into documented AI architectures, interfaces, implementation plan

Strong communication skills with experience presenting complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
